name: alia-plugin-provider-retry-advanced
description: VesnALIA's provider retry plus automatic resume after lost connectivity, with optional restart workflow recovery, stalled-turn watchdog and continuation follow-ups.
author: Sergey Petrov

alia.name: Provider retry advanced
alia.description: Retries provider overloads and subscription limits like the bundled Provider retry, resumes turns that failed for lost connectivity, and, when turned on, asks Claude Code to resume workflows a VesnALIA restart killed, restarts stalled turns once and follows up resumed turns that only promised to continue.

scripts.bundle: bunx --package alia-app@0.48.0 alia plugin build . && bun -e "const f = 'dist/server.js.map'; await Bun.write(f, (await Bun.file(f).text()).replaceAll(process.cwd() + '/', '../../'))"
